}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *[[Firefly]] logo, "ROC-06-PC PRO", "ROC-RK3399-PC PRO", :and "V1.1 2023.02.03" are silkscreened on the board.
{{See also|Firefly|T-Chip}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3399 • @1.4GHz Quad-Core ARM :(Cortex-A53) + @1.8GHz Dual-Core ARM (Cortex-A72) *GPU: ''Mali-T860 MP4'' (OpenGL ES3.1, OpenVG 1.1, OpenCL) :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Onboard Storage: 16MB (SPI), 32GB (eMMC) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *Wi-Fi: 802.11abgn/ac (1T1R), Bluetooth 5.0 BLE :[[Broadcom]] BCM43456 ([[AMPAK]] SDIO Module) *PCIe: 1x M.2 (M-Key) slot *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 1x USB 3.0 ports, :1x USB 3.0 Type-C (OTG/DP1.2) port *Power Source: 12V/2A barrel
